set.body:
Outcome

Represent permutation, sign-flip, and related inferential reindexings without folding them into validation.

Acceptance

- Exchangeability structure and statistic reduction are explicit scientific inputs.
- Permutations bind to the exact sample or partition axis.
- Invalid block, sign, or label actions are rejected.
- Seed paths are deterministic and domain-separated from fitting and tuning.
set.title: P3.5: implement exchangeability-bound RandomizationDesign
